plans.diagnosis: Low transit caused arm-lamp collision. Tool tip was at ~0.23m holding tin_1 hanging 0.08m below, while lamp_1 is 0.48m tall at [0.44,0.0] directly between robot base at origin and the work area at x~0.6. Via [0.73,0.0] kept the tin clear of jar_1 laterally but the forearm/link5 still passed over the lamp location at lamp-top height, evidenced by contact at [0.475,0.028,0.48] knocking lamp over 30.2cm. Fix by raising transit_height to 0.60m so both tool tip + hanging tin (~0.52m bottom) and the arm above it clear the 0.48m lamp top, while keeping the eastern via to avoid jar_1.

Attempt 2 failed by IK reach limit, not contact. Transit 0.60m exceeds workspace ceiling at the far radial distance of tin_1 (~0.67m from base). The high transit was to clear the 0.48m lamp with eastern via [0.73,0.0] which aligns the base-to-tool plane radially over lamp_1 at [0.44,0.0]. Fix: use reachable transit 0.35m (<0.54m limit) and route west of lamp via [0.25,0.0]. plans.diagnosis: Failure was arm-body collision with tall lamp, not TCP collision. Lamp_1 at [0.44,0] height 0.48 sits on the x-axis between robot base (origin) and work area. Transit was 0.25m so TCP at 0.231m during carry was below lamp top. Forearm link5 rides ~0.25m above TCP, so at ~0.48m = lamp top height. Path from [0.6,0.3] to [0.6,-0.3] via [0.73,0.0] forces a centered y~0 overflight directly over lamp - first hit t=4.396s at [0.475,0.028,0.48] by link5, toppling lamp 30.2cm. Jar_1 at [0.62,0] also lies on the low straight line. Fix: raise transit to 0.65m so TCP at 0.65m, tin bottom at 0.65-0.08=0.57m >0.48m lamp top and >0.1m jar, and forearm above TCP clears lamp, and remove eastern low via so carry and return stay high and straight from offset start to offset goal, lifting/lowering vertically far from lamp.

Attempt 2 IK failure was workspace limit, not collision. Transit 0.65m exceeds Panda reach at radius ~0.63-0.67m from base: max tool height is 0.54m above [0.6,0.3] and 0.59m at [0.589,0.225] where it asked 0.62m. Attempt 1 collision was arm-body overflight of lamp_1 on x-axis: any TCP with y~0 puts arm base->TCP directly over [0.44,0], and at TCP 0.231m forearm link5 was at 0.48m = lamp top, toppling it. Fix: lower transit to 0.50m which is <0.54m reachable limit at start/goal, still gives tin bottom 0.42m > jar 0.1m, and route via [0.25,0.0] west of lamp. Then TCP path closest to lamp is ~0.12m center distance >0.08m radii sum, and arm to via ends at x=0.25 before lamp x=0.44, so neither carry nor return ever aligns arm over lamp on y=0, avoiding both failures.

plans.diagnosis: Attempt 1 used transit_height 0.25 which is below the lamp top 0.48. The tool path from [0.6,0.3] via [0.73,0.0] to [0.6,-0.3] must cross y=0. The via point [0.73,0.0] is collinear with robot base at origin and lamp at [0.44,0.0]. So the arm reaching from base to the tool passes directly through the lamp cylinder. With tool tip at 0.25 the gripper/arm above the tip is still below 0.48 and collides with the tall lamp, disturbing it and failing undisturbed. Fix is to lift over the lamp: transit 0.6 puts tool tip and everything above it above 0.48, so arm clears lamp vertically, while hanging tin bottom at 0.52 clears the 0.1 high jar. Keep eastern via to keep lateral clearance from jar.

Attempt 2 failed by reachability, not collision. Lifting the tool tip to 0.6 at tin radius sqrt(0.6^2+0.3^2)=0.67 puts 3D distance from base sqrt(0.67^2+0.6^2)~0.9m, beyond Panda ~0.85m reach, and via [0.73,0.0] at 0.6 is sqrt(0.73^2+0.6^2)~0.94m. Hence IK fails and execution aborted before placement, so on tin_1 mat_1 failed with no contact events. The eastern via also does not fix the root cause: any y=0 point east of lamp at [0.44,0.0] is collinear base-lamp-tool, so the arm from origin to tool still passes over the lamp. Fix is to cross y=0 west of the lamp between base and lamp, e.g. via [0.3,0.0]. Then the arm ends before the lamp and never overflies it, so low transit 0.3 is sufficient and reachable. Lateral clearance tool to lamp ~0.14 at via and ~0.099 at closest segment >0.045+0.035, to jar ~0.3, to phone ~0.24, and hanging tin bottom 0.3-0.08=0.22 clears 0.1 jar.
